about: You Guys Are Getting Paid? is a four-panel grid from the comedy We're the Millers. Jason Sudeikis looks startled at top left, Jennifer Aniston is indignant at top right, Emma Roberts is annoyed at bottom left, and Will Poulter's Kenny looks lost at bottom right. Each character learns someone else is earning more, and the last one, Kenny, realizes he was never being paid at all. The format ranks four groups in the same situation from best off to worst off, with the punchline saved for the one who got nothing.
origin: The stills come from the 2013 film We're the Millers. The grid became a widely used meme in 2020.
usage:
There are four boxes, one per panel. The first can stay empty or set up the scenario. Panels two and three escalate the complaint: someone discovers a coworker earns more, then someone else says they earn far less. The last panel is Kenny's line, a version of "you guys are getting paid?", for the group that gets nothing.

It fits interns, volunteers, open-source maintainers, younger siblings, and any group that gets less recognition. The bigger the drop between panels three and four, the funnier the ending.
